idea: Compute a global table best[m] with its layouts once per process, for all m up to max(n) + 2√n, stored in a module-level cache. Every construction family (grids, replacements, partitions, substitutions) can then feed the others, and repeated calls cost nothing. This leaves most of the 60 s budget for numerical refinement of only the current n.
